# jy

> Tools to control JS from Python (jy for Js pY or Js python proxY)


## Pages in this subsection

- [jy](jy.html.md): Python functions to talk to Javascript
- [jy.bridge](jy.bridge.html.md): Python portals to JS
- [jy.js_parse](jy.js_parse.html.md): Utils to parse JS
- [jy.test](jy.test.html.md): | &#96;test_bridge&#96;     | Tests for the bridge module   |
- [jy.test.test_bridge](jy.test.test_bridge.html.md): Tests for the bridge module
- [jy.test.test_js_parse](jy.test.test_js_parse.html.md): Tests for js_bridge
- [jy.ts_parse](jy.ts_parse.html.md): Tools to parse TS code
- [jy.util](jy.util.html.md): General utils
